items.title: Jon Hendricks interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: to have Dave, Annie and Joe — oh, that was a perfect group.

ctx.x: On the sequel to the Basie thing you used Joe Williams as your fourth voice.

Yes, yes, that was the best time of my whole life, singing-wise, to have Dave, Annie and Joe — oh, that was a perfect group. Because Joe’s beautiful, rich, syrupy baritone you know, at the bottom of that stuff, just what it needed. It was so wonderful. I’ll never forget that. In fact we still talk about it, Joe and I still talk about that. He still talks about that. You know it was so wonderful. And he was just like a student. You know he didn’t act like a star or anything. He says, “well what do you want me to…
How has recording changed from then ‘til now for you?
